summary: Tested admin login-access controls (forced password change, admin reset, force logout, token_version invalidation, RBAC, safeguards) end-to-end. 17/17 backend pytest tests passed and all UI flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user uses payload.get('tv', 0) != user.get('token_version', 0). This correctly preserves backward compatibility for legacy tokens (no tv claim) when user has no token_version, but if an admin ever resets/force-logs-out a legacy user, their legacy token becomes invalid — expected behavior.

auth.py is ~240 lines and mixes auth, user CRUD, role templates, and meta endpoints. Consider splitting into routers/users.py and routers/roles.py per code-review guidelines (files should stay focused).
change-password payload is untyped dict; consider a Pydantic schema (ChangePasswordInput) for validation and OpenAPI clarity.
test_credentials: Used seeded demo accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; all destructive tests used throwaway TEST_* users cleaned up after.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users created via POST /api/auth/register and deleted via DELETE /api/users/{id} after each scenario; demo account passwords untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_login_access.py covers login regression (all 6 demo accounts), legacy JWT without tv accepted, forced password change (register + login + wrong current + success + old-token invalidation), admin reset (invalidates old pw + old token, sets must_change_password), force logout (invalidates token), self-safeguards (admin cannot reset own pw / force-logout self → 400), RBAC (doctor → 403; unauth change-password → 401). UI e2e verified: force-change gate shown, mismatch blocked, success clears gate; Team.js reset-pw and force-logout buttons work end-to-end.
